newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Pure Foods plans to venture into fastfoods.
newsitem.headline: Pure Foods plans to venture into fastfoods.

text.p: Pure Foods Corp is planning to venture into the fastfoods and franchising business this year to improve its foothold in the processed meat market, a senior official said on Monday.
Pure Foods Corp is the food subsidiary of conglomerate Ayala Corp.

"We're looking at the whole fastfood and franchising business as a way of adding value to the Pure Foods' brand name and the Pure Foods' business. We're looking at some opportunities on that front," Ayala president Jaime Augusto Zobel de Ayala told Reuters in an interview.
Pure Foods controls 50 to 60 percent of the processed meat market in the country.
Ayala said the company was negotiating with foreign and local firms for possible joint ventures in the food sector. He declined to give specific names.

"We have been in a number of discussions with number one, foreign partners in specific areas and number two some discussions with local payers to see whether we will have a fit of doing something together," he said.
"I do believe we have to put Pure Foods up to achieve a certain critical mass in the food business," he added, particularly in its poultry and flour milling operations.
